Egypt–United Kingdom Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (1975)
Egypt–UAE and Egypt–Saudi Arabia Reciprocal DTAAs on Income and Capital Taxation
EU–Egypt Association Agreement (2004) and Egypt–EORA trade protocols
Egypt membership in COMESA and Greater Arab Free Trade Area (GAFTA)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Combating Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002, as amended, and its Executive Regulations, as administered by the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU); Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as consolidated and amended by Companies Law No. 177 of 2019; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and GAFI UBO disclosure forms; Central Bank of Egypt KYC and CDD instructions; FATF Recommendations 24 and 25 on beneficial ownership transparency.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport of each shareholder, UBO, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority and Notary Public in the holder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention of 5 October 1961, in force for Egypt since 2020) OR Consular Legalization by the competent Egyptian Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good conduct / police clearance certificate of each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Criminal records authority of the country of residence (national police, Ministry of Justice, or FBI-style authority)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / corporate extract of each corporate shareholder, if any
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or Chamber of Commerce in the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Legalized and Arabic-translated Power of Attorney (LPOA) appointing the Egyptian incorporation counsel and resident manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the grantor's home jurisdiction, countersigned by the Egyptian Consulate or apostilled, then translated by an accredited translator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, followed by certified Arabic translation in Egypt

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds evidence covering the subscribed share capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank of account in the UBO's jurisdiction of residence, issued on bank letterhead in a form accepted under Central Bank of Egypt KYC rules
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or apostille where required; alternatively direct banker's verification acceptable to the Egyptian receiving bank under CBE AML circulars

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-filing and continuous screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the domestic terrorist-financing designation list administered by EMLCU under Law No. 80 of 2002. PEPs and their close associates are subject to enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and senior-management approval in line with FATF Recommendations 12 and 22, before submission of the incorporation file to GAFI and the Commercial Registry.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) single-window electronic portal - 'Invest in Egypt' (https://www.investinegypt.gov.eg), supplemented by the Commercial Registry service under the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade for registration of the same cleared name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be registered in Arabic and be phonetically unique and not deceptively similar to an existing Arabic or transliterated name on the national registry. An English or French transliteration may be added as a secondary trade name, but the Arabic name remains the legally operative name. The name must not contain any word that misleads as to the company's activity, liability status, or state sponsorship, and must end with the legal form indicator 'Limited Liability Company' (شركة ذات مسئولية محدودة).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: State, National, Republic, Government (requires prior Cabinet approval)
Military, Armed Forces, Police, Security Forces
Public Authority, Public Sector, Official Authority
Central Bank, Bank (requires CBE licensing), Money, Savings
Islamic or other religious/holy references, names of cities classified as restricted heritage names
Words implying sovereign guarantee, government sponsorship, or resemblance to Egyptian State emblem
Identical or deceptively similar tokens to active registered trademarks or existing company names
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may refile a revised name or submit a written objection to the GAFI Name Clearance Committee within 30 days of the rejection notice, paying a refiling fee and attaching a legal memorandum on distinguishability and phonetic uniqueness. If the administrative objection is denied, the applicant may file an appeal before the Investment Grievance Committee established under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 within 60 days, and thereafter seek judicial review before the State Council (Administrative Court) within 60 days of the final administrative decision. A name reservation lapsing after 30 days without registration must be renewed by a fresh reservation application.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual-only offices are not accepted for a steel-structure prefab EPC LLC. GAFI and the Commercial Registry require a physical registered office in Egypt evidenced by a notarized and stamped lease agreement or title deed, with a real desk, signboard, and local management presence. Licensed serviced-office suites within recognized business complexes may satisfy the form requirement only if they provide dedicated physical space and are accepted by GAFI's registration unit; pure PO-box or virtual-mailroom arrangements are rejected.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-elevated: estimated 30-40% probability of an unannounced physical inspection by GAFI, the Tax Authority, or the Labor Office within the first full operating year. The percentage rises toward 50% or higher for entities seeking Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) incentives, import-code registration for steel inputs, or VAT refund status, as inspectors cross-check actual premises, employee attendance, equipment presence, and construction-site contracts.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018), Articles 1-11, 26-52, and Executive Regulations
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Foreign Trade (GAFI) - Companies Registration Department
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLC; capital must be fully subscribed and deposited into an escrow/guarantee account with an Egyptian bank before registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers to the Memorandum of Association of [Company Name] hereby adopt the attached Articles of Incorporation and constitute the initial Board of Directors. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company in Egypt be established at [address], and [name] is appointed as Manager/director to represent the Company in legal and banking matters. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the capital subscribed be deposited in escrow with [Bank], and the Manager be authorized to execute and file all incorporation documents, pay statutory fees, and take all actions necessary to obtain registration and the associated operational permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the name reservation application through GAFI's online portal with the proposed company name and primary business purpose. Ensure the name is not identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered entity. The reservation certificate is issued after internal screening.
required_dossiers: Copy of valid ID/passport for each founding member
Power of attorney (if filed by a representative)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file a new name application or submit an administrative appeal to the GAFI Registration Committee within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Ministry of Justice - Real Estate and Notarization Authority)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Incorporation in Arabic. Ensure all subscribers or their legal representatives appear before the notary public to sign. The notary authenticates the signatures and the document becomes an official deed for registration.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Valid passports/national IDs of all subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries any clause, amend the draft to comply with formal legal requirements and resubmit for notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian Commercial Bank (e.g., through GAFI's account opening facilitation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the company's name and deposit the full subscribed capital. Obtain a capital deposit certificate confirming the amount and account details. Withdrawal is only permitted after the company is incorporated and operating.
required_dossiers: Tax identification numbers of shareholders (if resident)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional anti-money-laundering documentation, promptly supply proof of lawful source of funds or use an alternate licensed bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Filing with GAFI and Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Authority for Investment and Foreign Trade (GAFI) - Companies Registration Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation file through the GAFI One-Stop Shop. Pay the statutory filing fees and registration fees. GAFI verifies the documents and issues a certificate of incorporation; the same file is transmitted to the Commercial Registry.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Power of attorney and passport copies of managers
Lease contract or title deed for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI raises a query, submit the requested clarifications or missing documentation within 30 days; decisions may be appealed before the GAFI internal grievance committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority and National Social Insurance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation, register at the Tax Authority to obtain the tax card and VAT certificate (if taxable turnover exceeds the threshold). Register employees with the Social Insurance Authority and file the commercial ledger commencement statement with the Commercial Registry.
required_dossiers: Proof of registered office (lease or ownership)
Board resolution appointing a tax agent/accounting manager
Employment contracts and social insurance forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is delayed, request a compliance certificate from GAFI and escalate through the Tax Authority's administrative grievance unit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) / GAFI License Services
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License (Permanent Manufacturing License) under the Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (Environmental Screening) – a full EIA Report is not ordinarily mandated for light steel fabrication; however, a full EIA is triggered if surface treatment, pickling, galvanizing, or spray-painting lines are installed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must comply with Ministerial Decree No. 92/2013 (pH 6-9, BOD≤60 mg/l, COD≤120 mg/l, TSS≤30 mg/l); particulate and VOC emissions must meet Law No. 4/1994 and PM2.5/PM10 ambient limits; hazardous waste (spent acids, solvents, paint residues) must be managed under Ministerial Decree No. 5/2014.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Civil Defense Authority covering welding/fabrication shops; structural load inspection by the municipal engineering department for freight cranes and prefabricated assembly bays; and occupational health and safety clearance from the Ministry of Manpower (Workplace Safety Inspection).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance - Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA); taxpayer portal: https://portal.eta.gov.eg; official information portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign LLC must register with ETA before commencing taxable activity. Submit Arabic-translated certificate of incorporation and constitutive documents, board resolution appointing local tax representative, power of attorney, Egyptian trade/commercial registration and office lease, identity documents, foreign currency remittance/payment instrument, and projected annual turnover statement. ETA issues a unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) and a tax card; VAT registration is mandatory when annual taxable supplies exceed threshold and can be voluntary after ETA acceptance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; resident Egyptian LLC is taxed at entity level on worldwide income as a juridical person; non-resident LLC operating through Egyptian PE is taxed on Egyptian-source income only. No pass-through status is available for the standard LLC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election is recognized under Egyptian law. Eligible small/micro enterprises may elect the simplified turnover-based tax regime under the Income Tax Law; a foreign investor may elect investment incentives in Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) free/tax-eligible zones that suspend taxes/VAT, but such election does not reclassify the LLC as a non-taxable pass-through. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016 as amended (replaced the General Sales Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration: annual taxable turnover exceeding EGP 500,000; voluntary registration: taxable persons with annual turnover of at least EGP 250,000 may apply; additional ETA e-invoicing/e-receipt stage thresholds require digital registration irrespective of turnover once the taxpayer is selected.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egyptian Tax Authority mandates real-time e-invoicing for registered taxpayers in phased enrolment waves. B2B/B2G e-invoices and B2C e-receipts must be created via ETA-approved solutions, submitted to the ETA platform through public API in XML/JSON and validated/cleared before the transaction is legally complete; each cleared invoice receives an ETA QR code/digital stamp and unique UUID. Inability to obtain ETA clearance blocks the seller's input VAT deduction and is treated as non-issuance of invoice for VAT settlement purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAT-registered exporter may claim 0% VAT on exported goods where goods physically depart Egypt under a valid customs export declaration, sale is to a non-resident customer, proceeds are received in convertible foreign currency through Egyptian banks within the Central Bank of Egypt deadline, and the export sale is correctly declared in the VAT return. Exported services and offshore EPC/steel-structure assembly and engineering services supplied wholly to and consumed by a non-resident outside Egypt may also qualify for zero-rating if backed by contract, foreign currency remittance, and absence of economic use inside Egypt.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Final Customs Export Declaration approved by the Egyptian Customs Authority (Export SAD/Bayan) matching the VAT invoice values and HS codes
Original or certified copy Bill of Lading / Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Egypt and delivery to the foreign buyer or project site
Inward Foreign Exchange Remittance Certificate issued by the Egyptian commercial bank, evidencing receipt of export proceeds in convertible currency
Commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, sale contract/purchase order and, where applicable, letter of credit or SWIFT MT103 credit advice
ETA export supporting file containing the e-invoice export entries and, for related-party exports, transfer pricing documentation if requested
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA and Egyptian Customs may jointly audit export files within the five-year VAT assessment horizon. Zero-rating is clawed back if the goods are not exported, proceeds are not repatriated by the deadline, or documentation is false or non-conforming; the clawback assesses output VAT at 14% plus monthly delay surcharge and revokes refunds/input credits. Fraudulent export declarations constitute tax evasion under VAT Law No. 67/2016 and attract criminal fines, imprisonment, automatic suspension of export and tax registration, and publication of assessment before the internal tax appeals committee.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) — Banking Supervision and Foreign Exchange Sectors, with the Egyptian Money Laundering Combating Unit (EMLCU) and the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) for non-bank oversight; statutory mandate under Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020 and AML Law No. 80 of 2002 (as amended).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a partial-convertibility regime: the Egyptian Pound (EGP) is not freely deliverable offshore. Current-account flows (genuine import of steel inputs and export proceeds under EPC contracts) are freely convertible through CBE-licensed banks upon presentation of underlying commercial documents, a valid tax card, an import register entry, and an FX declaration. Capital-account flows are restricted: inward equity is open to 100% non-resident ownership under the GAFI investment regime and is registrable for future repatriation; external loans and derivative positions require CBE loan registration or prior authorization. Since the March 2024 exchange-rate liberalization under the IMF Extended Fund Facility, the dual-rate system and the foreign-investor repatriation queue were abolished, and the EGP floats at interbank market prices; genuine commercial FX demand clears within days. Profit remittance hurdles: an LLC must first appropriate the statutory reserve of 10% of annual profits until it reaches 50% of issued capital; distribution then requires audited financials, tax clearance or tax card, UBO and shareholder-registry declarations, and the CBE inward-investment registration certificate. Banks apply standard KYC and sanctions screening; dividends due to a foreign strategic parent are freely transferable once those documents are clean.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory collection window: export proceeds must be repatriated through CBE-licensed banks within 90 days of the bill of lading or airway bill date; an extension to 180 days may be approved by the CBE on documented receivables-financing grounds. Mandatory conversion: the historical fixed surrender ratios (e.g., the 50% surrender applicable before the 2016 float) no longer apply; exporters may retain 100% of proceeds in a foreign-currency account and convert at market when needed. Compliance: the exporting bank submits the proceeds record to the CBE electronic declaration system and reconciles the invoice value against the SWIFT credit; late collection, leakage, or retention outside Egypt triggers supervisory escalation and denial of subsequent trade-finance lines. For the steel prefab EPC model, milestone billings under the EPC contract are treated as export proceeds only where title to goods passes to a non-resident buyer and the goods physically leave Egypt under a customs export declaration.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Treasury Account / LC and FX Desk
Corporate Transactional Account / Trade Finance Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: LOW as a primary treasury rail and MEDIUM only as an auxiliary collections channel. The CBE does not permit an offshore EMI to hold EGP accounts or issue EGP IBANs to a resident LLC; any payment institution operating in Egypt must be licensed under Law No. 194 of 2020 and the CBE payment-systems framework (Law No. 18 of 2019). A non-resident parent may use an offshore EMI to fund an equity contribution or shareholder loan by inbound wire, but the EGP treasury, tax payments, LC operations, and payroll must run through CBE-licensed bank accounts. Offshore EMIs also raise enhanced-due-diligence flags because intermediated flows obscure the FX declaration trail; settlement into an unregistered intermediary account will be rejected or delayed by Egyptian receiving banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical appearance is the norm: signatories and the designated senior manager must attend an in-person KYC interview at the opening branch; non-resident owners may alternatively complete a remote interview and grant a notarized or Egyptian-consular legalized power of attorney to a resident signatory. UBOs holding 25% or more must provide certified passport copies, proof of address, and source-of-wealth statements. CBE's digital onboarding under Law No. 18 of 2019 is currently limited to certain retail and low-risk corporate profiles; it is not extended to treasury accounts with LC packages, FX dealing, or inward-capital registration, where the relationship manager must co-sign the account mandate and the CBE form declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated LLC with no operating history and a foreign parent structure lacking audited financials.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized Articles of Association and GAFI incorporation certificate; board resolution appointing signatories; opening balance sheet audited by a locally registered auditor; foreign parent's audited consolidated financials and bank reference; business plan evidencing the prefab steel pipeline (subcontracts, letters of intent, order book); UBO passports plus source-of-wealth declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value steel procurement via letters of credit with multiple Tier-2 steel suppliers and potential invoice mismatches.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete trade chain: pro-forma invoice, purchase contract with Incoterms, mill test certificates (e.g., EN 10025 or ISO 630), transport documents, marine insurance policy, Egyptian customs declaration processed through CargoX or AICS, and supplier incorporation and tax-identification proof confirming genuine non-sanctioned mill origin.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction flows exceeding EGP 10 million or USD 500,000 per month, triggering enhanced due diligence and Beneficial Ownership look-through.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax card and annual tax clearance certificate; audited financial statements by a Big-Four-affiliated firm; VAT and e-invoice ledger; board treasury policy; customer and supplier onboarding files; approved vendor master list; confirmation that all payables flow to genuine counterparties with no cash or circular-transaction leakage.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions-corridor exposure in the steel supply chain (trading risk with Russia, Iran, Syria-adjacent rebar, or transshipment hubs screening against UN, EU, or OFAC lists).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Real-time sanctions screening logs; country-of-origin certificates from each mill; end-user and ultimate-utilization statements; restrictive L/C wording excluding sanctioned-origin cargo; supplier written confirmation of non-diversion and anti-corruption compliance; legal opinion from Egyptian counsel on UN, EU, and OFAC alignment.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant injection of foreign share capital or shareholder loan: wire via SWIFT MT103 from the non-resident parent's bank to the LLC's designated CBE-licensed account, using an IMF-referenced purpose code corresponding to 'share capital in a limited liability company' (equity injection) or 'intercompany loan'. The receiving bank verifies the GAFI incorporation certificate, the articles of association, the shareholders' ledger, and the board resolution, then issues an inward-remittance certificate and registers the flow on the CBE FX-declaration system. For shareholder loans exceeding USD 1 million, a CBE loan-registration form and drawdown schedule must be filed; conversion of injected USD or EUR into EGP must be executed at a licensed dealer at the prevailing interbank market rate, and the company capital register must be updated with the translated EGP amount. The route must be a direct bank-to-bank transfer free of intermediate offshore settlement accounts to preserve the FX declaration trail and the ability to remit dividends later.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails: (1) irrevocable commercial letters of credit issued by SWIFT MT700 or MT710 for steel raw-material imports and prefabrication equipment, governed by UCP600 and typically on 90-days-sight terms; (2) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for services, freight, insurance, minor spares, and overseas professional fees; (3) documentary collection (DP or DA) only for trusted repeat suppliers. Bid and performance guarantees are issued as SWIFT MT760 against the same collateral line for EPC tenders. Egyptian banks require the underlying import application, customs registration, tax-card validity, and a stated end-use purpose for every outward remittance; FX disbursements are booked at the CBE interbank market rate and must match the approved purchase order to avoid FX declaration mismatches. Bank policy after the 2024 liberalization increasingly requires a matching purchase-order reference and documentary evidence of real trade-backed end use.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX outright forward (deliverable) against USD/EGP or EUR/EGP, tenor up to 12 months, available from CBE-licensed banks only where an underlying trade or receivable exposure is documented; settlement occurs at the agreed forward rate against the interbank fixing.
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on USD/EGP, arranged offshore or back-to-back through the onshore bank's foreign branch, used when EGP deliverability is constrained; final settlement in USD or EUR.
Cross-currency swap (USD/EGP or EUR/EGP) matching steel-procurement import liabilities against EPC contract receivables; subject to CBE authorized-dealer review and documented exposure evidence.

Plain-vanilla FX options (call or put) at bank discretion for corporate hedging with an approved treasury mandate; structured, exotic, or leveraged products are not permissible for non-bank EGP users.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Form 8) with audited financial statements and tax reconciliation schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 April for a calendar fiscal year; any alternative fiscal year-end requires filing within 4 months from the fiscal year close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 1% per month on unpaid tax; late filing penalty up to 20% of the aggregate tax due; persistent non-filing may trigger administrative assessment, enforced collection, and suspension of the entity's tax card.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registry renewal fee and confirmation of company particulars
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Commercial Registry Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June for calendar-based renewals, or within the first 30 days following the anniversary of the initial commercial registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative late fine ranging from EGP 100 to EGP 1,000; continued non-renewal for more than one year may subject the LLC to strike-off from the Commercial Registry and loss of legal capacity to contract.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual resolution approving financial statements and renewal of directors' authority, filed with the corporate file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Companies Registry and internal shareholders' general assembly
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after each fiscal year-end for the shareholders' annual general meeting; filing of the resolution within 15 days following the meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under the Egyptian Companies Law for late general assembly convocation; failure to file the resolution may delay subsequent statutory filings and incur daily administrative penalties up to EGP 2,000.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent statutory audit for all Egyptian LLCs; no turnover-based exemption exists. The company must appoint a certified public accountant registered with the Egyptian Syndicate of Accountants and Auditors, and the audited financial statements must accompany the annual tax return.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), substantially aligned with IFRS, as issued by the Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority and mandated for corporate financial reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every transfer of shares or change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be recorded in the register of partners and reported to GAFI as an amendment to the commercial file. An annual confirmation of the UBO register is submitted with the annual general meeting documents; failure to update registers for three consecutive years exposes the LLC to administrative strike-off and fines under Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002.

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% (Law No. 26 of 2020, Unified Income Tax Law; standard corporate rate for resident LLCs; banks and oil/telecom sectors subject to higher special rates)
